news.title: CENTCOM confirms 2 US service members killed in Jordan, another missing
news.summary: Two U.S. service members were killed, and one is still missing after Iran hit two military bases in Jordan on Friday, according to U.S. Central Command (Centcom). Additionally, four American service members were “medically evacuated” to hospitals in Jordan and have since been discharged. Other troops who sustained minor injuries were evaluated and have returned…
